children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test a support at $7.13-3/4 per bushel, a break below which could open the way toward $6.98-1/2.
After failing to break a resistance at $7.30-1/2, the contract broke the support at $7.23. The next support will be at $7.13-3/4.

The bounce from the September 15 low of $7.11-1/4 has been deeply reversed. The reversal indicates a continuation of the downtrend from $7.95, which might be extending toward $6.98-1/2, the 100% projection level of a wave C from $7.62-1/2.
A break above $7.23, now a resistance, may lead to a gain to $7.30-1/2. A further gain would signal the continuation of the short uptrend from $7.11-1/4.
On the daily chart, trending signals turned neutral, as the market is stuck in a narrow range of $7.13-3/4 to $7.30. An escape would suggest a direction.
